summary: Mayfair Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting the voting results of its annual general and special meeting held June 25, 2026. Shareholders re-elected five directors, re-appointed Davidson Company LLP as auditors, and re-approved the Omnibus Incentive Plan. This is a routine post-meeting disclosure with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring. The filing contains no transactional terms, advisor mandates, or structural changes. As a non-US issuer, this 6-K serves the same function as a domestic 8-K for meeting results. There is no risk-arb angle; this is a governance update only.
